scope_note: Audit decisions for the 14 skill-level app-region routing mismatch warnings surfaced by the Phase 3 content inventory report. Entries are skill/question pairs because one warning can contain multiple canonical question IDs.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, but DeepSeek and the question text identify a separable differential-equation population model.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra discriminant/root-condition evidence and from the algebra Guardian candidates.
entries.rationale: The mark scheme rewards separating variables, integrating, using an initial condition, and interpreting the model. It is not discriminant/root-condition evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, but DeepSeek and the question text identify a complex-number quadratic.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra discriminant/root-condition evidence.
entries.rationale: The mark scheme rewards complex arithmetic and conjugate manipulation, not discriminant or real-root conditions.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, but DeepSeek and the question text identify a complex-number quadratic.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra modulus-case evidence.
entries.rationale: The question has no modulus equation, modulus inequality, or case split.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was parametric_equations, while the question text and DeepSeek label identify an absolute-value inequality.
entries.recommended_resolution: Correct the question-bank topic to algebra and subtopic to modulus inequalities.
entries.rationale: The question asks for an absolute-value graph and inequality; the reviewed algebra modulus skill is the safer route.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, while DeepSeek/app routing identify an exponential equation.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra structure evidence and correct the question-bank topic to logarithms_and_exponentials.
entries.rationale: The mark scheme rewards laws of indices and solving an exponential equation, not the reviewed algebra rearrangement skill.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, while the question text is a logarithmic equation.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra structure evidence and correct the question-bank topic to logarithms_and_exponentials.
entries.rationale: The mark scheme rewards log laws and a resulting quadratic, not the reviewed algebra rearrangement skill.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was algebra, while DeepSeek/app routing identify trigonometry.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from algebra structure evidence and from the algebra Guardian candidates; correct the question-bank topic to trigonometry.
entries.rationale: The question asks for trigonometric R-form and a related trigonometric integral.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions, while the reviewed skill is forming a context model.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from forming-context-model evidence.
entries.rationale: The question gives the differential equation and asks students to solve it using partial fractions; it does not ask students to form the model from context.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was logarithms_and_exponentials, while DeepSeek/app routing and the mark scheme identify partial-fractions integration.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from log-linearisation evidence and correct the question-bank topic to integration.
entries.rationale: The logarithms appear as integrated partial-fraction terms; the question is not linearisation evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic was numerical_methods, while DeepSeek/app routing identify differential equations.
entries.recommended_resolution: Remove this question from iteration-formula evidence and correct the question-bank topic to differential_equations.
entries.rationale: The iteration is one subpart after model formation and differential-equation solving; the full question is not clean iteration-formula evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek gives an unmapped Calculus label; the question has differentiation and integration subparts.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until a reviewer decides whether this mixed log-calculus question should remain differentiation evidence or be represented with part-level metadata.
entries.rationale: The question contains product/quotient-rule evidence, but the app's single-region route cannot express the log-function context and calculus subparts together.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek gives an unmapped calculus label with stationary-point subtopic.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed as either differentiation evidence, log-calculus bridge evidence, or both with part-level metadata.
entries.rationale: The question is a stationary-point task involving logarithms, so both the app route and reviewed skill route are defensible.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is parametric_equations; DeepSeek/app routing emphasize integration by parts; the question has a maximum-point subpart.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level differentiation versus integration evidence.
entries.rationale: The first subpart supports differentiation, while the larger second subpart supports integration.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels are logarithms_and_exponentials; the reviewed skill is implicit differentiation.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed as part-level implicit-differentiation evidence or log-calculus bridge evidence.
entries.rationale: The question is an implicit differentiation problem containing exponential terms.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels are logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek subtopic is implicit_differentiation.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed as part-level implicit-differentiation evidence or log-calculus bridge evidence.
entries.rationale: The question explicitly requires implicit differentiation of logarithmic expressions.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek gives an unmapped Calculus label.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for whether it belongs under implicit log/exponential differentiation or only under product/quotient differentiation.
entries.rationale: The question uses logarithmic differentiation context but is not clearly implicit differentiation.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: DeepSeek/app routing emphasize integration by parts; the question also asks for a maximum point.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level stationary-point evidence.
entries.rationale: The first subpart is stationary-point evidence, but the whole question route is integration.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek gives an unmapped Calculus label.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level stationary-point evidence.
entries.rationale: The question asks for the exact stationary point of a logarithmic curve, which spans log context and calculus evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels are numerical_methods; the first subpart asks for derivative evidence.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level tangent/gradient evidence inside a numerical-methods question.
entries.rationale: The whole question is routed to numerical methods, but it contains a derivative subpart.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; the second subpart is a definite integral.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level integration evidence from the definite-integral subpart.
entries.rationale: The question combines partial-fraction setup and exact integration.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is parametric_equations; DeepSeek gives an unmapped Integration and Differentiation subtopic.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level area/integration evidence.
entries.rationale: The question contains both an area integral and a maximum-point derivative task.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; the second subpart is a definite integral.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level integration using partial fractions.
entries.rationale: The question combines decomposition and integration evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; DeepSeek subtopic mentions integration using partial fractions.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level integration using partial fractions.
entries.rationale: The question combines decomposition and integration evidence.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; DeepSeek subtopic is binomial_expansion.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed; this looks more like partial fractions plus expansion than integration.
entries.rationale: The question may not be valid integration evidence even though partial fractions are present.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; DeepSeek subtopic mentions differential equations.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for whether this should be differential-equation solving evidence, integration evidence, or both with part-level metadata.
entries.rationale: The question solves a differential equation using partial fractions.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize partial fractions; DeepSeek subtopic is binomial expansion.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed; this looks more like partial fractions plus expansion than integration.
entries.rationale: The current reviewed skill-map route may be too broad without part-level metadata.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local topic is logarithms_and_exponentials; DeepSeek/app routing identify implicit differentiation.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed as a log-calculus bridge or part-level implicit-differentiation item.
entries.rationale: The question is an implicit differentiation problem built from a logarithmic relation.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: Local and DeepSeek labels emphasize integration; the first subpart asks for a trigonometric identity proof.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level trigonometric identity evidence.
entries.rationale: The question combines identity proof and integration.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: DeepSeek/app routing emphasize integration; the first subpart asks for a reciprocal/double-angle proof.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level trigonometric identity evidence.
entries.rationale: The question combines identity proof and integration.

entries.source_of_conflicting_label: DeepSeek/app routing emphasize integration; the first subpart asks for a reciprocal/double-angle proof.
entries.recommended_resolution: Keep visible until reviewed for part-level reciprocal/double-angle evidence.
entries.rationale: The question combines reciprocal trigonometry, double-angle work, and integration.
